agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted condition bug in sqlparse/filters/tokens.py's _CaseFilter.process (used by KeywordCaseFilter): changed `if not (ttype in self.ttype)` to `if ttype in self.ttype`. This was causing keyword-case conversion to apply to everything except keywords instead of only keywords, breaking CLI in-place formatting, format keyword_case option, and psql command preservation (issue469). Verified fix with manual tests for keyword_case upper/lower, combined keyword+identifier case, and psql backslash command passthrough.
